about.title: About Fursuit Studio
about.content:
Fursuit Studio is a small commission-based studio building custom, ready-made, and pre-order fursuits for customers worldwide. We started out making suits for friends in the fandom, and grew into a full-time workshop without losing the parts that mattered most to us: careful construction, honest communication, and characters that actually feel like the people wearing them.

Every custom commission is built to order by hand, using the reference materials and measurements you provide. Ready-made and pre-order pieces go through the same process, just on our own schedule rather than yours — so you can get a finished suit without the wait of a full custom build.

We ship worldwide and support customers across the US, UK, EU, and Australia, with pricing shown in your local currency and support in several languages. If you have questions before ordering, our Contact page is the fastest way to reach us.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.content:
Answers to the questions we hear most often. If you don't see what you're looking for, contact us and we'll help directly.

## How does the commission process work?
Start with a quote request describing your character, including reference images and any details about horns, tails, or design preferences. We'll review it and follow up with pricing and an estimated timeline. Once you accept the quote and pay the deposit, we begin work.

## What payment methods do you accept?
We accept credit and debit cards, Alipay, and Revolut Pay through Stripe, as well as PayPal and bank transfer via Wise. Prices are shown in your selected currency, and the amount charged is confirmed at checkout or on your invoice.

## How long does a custom commission take?
Most custom commissions take about 3–6 months from when work begins to shipping, depending on complexity and our current queue. We'll confirm a more specific estimate with your quote. Ready-made items ship promptly, and pre-order items ship within the window shown on the product page.

## Can I make changes after placing my order?
Design changes are usually possible before production begins, sometimes at an additional cost depending on the stage of work. Significant changes requested after production has started may require cancelling and restarting the order — see our Returns & Refunds policy for details.

## Do you ship internationally, and who pays customs?
Yes, we ship worldwide by courier. International orders may be subject to customs duties, import taxes, or handling fees charged by your country on arrival — these are the responsibility of the recipient and aren't included in your order total.

## Do I need an account to place an order?
Yes. Creating an account lets us securely collect your shipping details and keep a record of your order history. You can sign up with just a nickname, email, and password — we only ask for your full name and address when you place an order or request a quote.

## What if something is wrong with my order?
Contact us with your order reference and we'll help make it right. Ready-made items can be returned within 14 days of delivery if unworn and in original condition, and any suit is covered by our warranty against manufacturing faults — see our Returns & Refunds and Terms of Service pages for details.

fursuitCare.title: Fursuit Care Guide
fursuitCare.content:
A little care goes a long way toward keeping your fursuit looking and feeling great for years. Here's how we recommend looking after it.

## Everyday Wear
Avoid eating or drinking in your fursuit, and take breaks in a cool, shaded area during long wear sessions to avoid overheating and excess sweat. Keep your suit away from open flames, hot surfaces, and sharp edges that could snag the fur or damage the base.

## Cleaning
Spot-clean small marks with a damp cloth and a small amount of mild, fur-safe detergent, then let the area air dry completely before storing or wearing the suit again. Avoid machine washing or drying, and avoid soaking foam or resin parts, which can warp or lose their shape.

## Storage
Store your suit somewhere cool, dry, and out of direct sunlight, ideally on a wig head or hanger so the fur and shape hold up over time. Avoid sealed plastic bags for long-term storage, since trapped moisture can lead to mildew — a breathable garment bag works well.

## Repairs
Minor issues like loose seams or a stray thread are easiest to fix early, before they get worse. If your suit was made by us and develops a fault due to how it was constructed, contact us — it's covered under our warranty. For everything else, we're happy to quote a repair.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.content:
This policy explains what personal information we collect, how we use it, and the choices you have. It applies to your use of this website and the services described on it.

## Information We Collect
We collect the information you provide directly — your nickname, email address, and password when you create an account; your full name and shipping address when you place an order or request a commission quote; and any character details, reference images, or files you share with your commission request. We also collect basic technical information automatically, such as your browser type, general location inferred from your IP address, and the pages you visit, to keep the site secure and working correctly.

## How We Use Your Information
We use your information to create and manage your account, process orders and commission requests, communicate with you about your purchase or quote, provide customer support, and detect and prevent fraud or abuse of our forms and checkout. We do not sell your personal information, and we do not use it for third-party advertising.

## Cookies & Similar Technologies
We use a small number of cookies that are necessary for the site to work: to keep you signed in, remember your language and currency preference, and protect our forms from automated abuse. We don't use third-party advertising or tracking cookies. You can control cookies through your browser settings, though blocking essential cookies may prevent parts of the site — such as sign-in — from working.

## Third-Party Service Providers
We share your information with a small number of providers who help us run the site, and only to the extent needed for them to provide their service to us: Clerk (account creation and sign-in), Stripe, PayPal, and Wise (payment processing), Sanity (product catalog and order records), Resend (order and quote confirmation emails), and Upstash (short-term abuse prevention on our forms and checkout). None of these providers may use your information for their own marketing purposes.

## Data Security
We rely on our providers' industry-standard security measures — encrypted connections, encrypted storage, and access controls — to protect your information. We never store your full card number ourselves; payment details are handled directly by Stripe, PayPal, or Wise. No method of transmission or storage is completely secure, but we work to protect your information appropriately.

## Your Rights
Depending on where you live, you may have the right to access, correct, or delete the personal information we hold about you, object to or restrict certain processing, or receive a copy of your data in a portable format. If you are in the European Economic Area, the UK, or Switzerland, you also have the right to lodge a complaint with your local data protection authority. To exercise any of these rights, contact us using the details on our Contact page, subject to any records we're required to keep for accounting or legal purposes.

## International Data Transfers
We and our service providers may process your information in countries outside your own, including the United States. Where this involves transferring personal data from the European Economic Area, the UK, or Switzerland, we rely on appropriate safeguards such as our providers' standard contractual clauses.

## Children's Privacy
Our services are not directed to children, and we do not knowingly collect personal information from anyone under 16. If you believe a child has provided us with personal information, please contact us and we will delete it.

## Changes to This Policy
We may update this policy from time to time as our services change. We'll post the current version on this page.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.content:
By placing an order or submitting a commission quote request, you agree to these terms. Prices are shown in your selected currency for convenience; the amount charged is confirmed at checkout or on your invoice.

## Work Aspects
All commission work is carried out under the Fursuit Studio name. To start work on your character, please provide a clear reference sheet or as many reference images as possible during the quote process. Clear, timely communication throughout the build helps us finish your suit on schedule and to your expectations. We reserve the right to decline any order or commission at our discretion. If a client is unreasonable or repeatedly unresponsive, we may cancel the order; any refund follows our Returns & Refunds policy.

## Orders & Payment
For ready-made and pre-order items, payment is collected in full at checkout via Stripe, PayPal, or Wise bank transfer. For custom commissions, once your quote is agreed a deposit is required before we begin work, with the remaining balance due before your finished suit ships — see "Payment Plans" below for larger commissions.

## Payment Plans
For larger commissions, we may offer a payment plan spread over several months. A non-refundable deposit secures your place in the queue, and we'll agree a schedule for the rest of the balance together. If your circumstances change, please let us know as early as possible so we can find a workable arrangement — missed payments may delay the start of work.

## Changes to Your Design
Design changes can usually be made before production begins, sometimes at an additional cost depending on the stage of work. Significant changes requested after production has started may not be possible without cancelling and restarting the order — see our Returns & Refunds policy for how this affects any refund.

## Measurements
For custom commissions, we'll provide guidance on how to take the measurements we need. It's your responsibility to measure carefully and follow that guidance; while we review submitted measurements for anything that looks unusual, we can't be responsible for a suit that doesn't fit due to inaccurate measurements.

## Production Time
Ready-made items ship promptly after purchase, and pre-order items ship within the window shown on the product page. Custom commissions typically take about 3–6 months from when work begins to shipping, depending on complexity and our current queue — we'll confirm a more specific estimate with your quote.

## Warranty
We stand behind the quality of our work. If a fault appears that's due to how the suit was made, contact us and we'll repair it at no extra cost to you (you're responsible for shipping it to us). Damage from normal wear, accidents, or improper care isn't covered, but we're happy to quote a repair.

## Intellectual Property
All character designs, artwork, and product photography on this site are the property of Fursuit Studio or our artists and may not be reproduced without permission. Custom character designs created for you remain your character, but our patterns, techniques, and construction methods remain ours.

## Limitation of Liability
We aim to accurately describe every product and commission process, but we don't guarantee the site will be error-free or uninterrupted, and we're not liable for indirect or incidental damages arising from your use of the site, to the fullest extent permitted by law.

shipping.title: Shipping & Customs
shipping.content:
We ship worldwide by courier. Shipping is calculated as a flat rate based on your delivery region, shown below and added to your order total at checkout.

International orders may be subject to customs duties, import taxes, or handling fees charged by your country upon arrival. These charges are the responsibility of the recipient and are not included in your order total — please check your local customs rules before ordering.

Production and shipping timelines vary by product: ready-made items ship promptly after purchase, pre-order items ship within the window shown on the product page, and custom commissions follow the timeline agreed during your quote.

returns.title: Returns & Refunds
returns.content:
Ready-made items can be returned within 14 days of delivery if unworn and in original condition; contact us to arrange a return. Return shipping costs are the responsibility of the customer unless the item arrived damaged or defective.

Pre-order items follow the same return policy once delivered. Because pre-orders reserve a production slot, deposits may be non-refundable if you cancel after production has begun — details are provided on the product page.

Custom commissions are made specifically for you, so once work has started they are generally not eligible for a refund. If there's an issue with the quality or accuracy of a finished commission, contact us and we'll work with you to make it right.

To start a return or refund request, contact us with your order reference and we'll guide you through the next steps.

cookies.title: Cookies Policy
cookies.content:
This policy explains what cookies are, which ones we use, and how you can control them. "Cookies" here also covers similar technologies, such as local storage used by your browser.

## What Is a Cookie?
A cookie is a small text file that a website asks your browser to store on your device. It lets the site remember information about your visit — such as your preferences or whether you're signed in — the next time you load a page.

## Why We Use Cookies
We use cookies to keep the site working the way you'd expect: remembering your language and currency choice, keeping you signed in as you move between pages, and helping us tell real visitors from automated abuse on our forms and checkout.

## Types of Cookies We Use
Session cookies are temporary and are deleted when you close your browser; we use these to help protect our forms and checkout from automated abuse. Persistent cookies remain on your device for longer and are used to keep you signed in across visits and remember your language and currency preference.

## Third-Party Cookies
When you complete a purchase, our payment providers (Stripe or PayPal) may set their own cookies on their hosted checkout pages to process your payment securely and prevent fraud. These cookies are set and controlled by the payment provider, not by us — please refer to their own privacy and cookie policies for details.

## Cookies We Don't Use
We do not use cookies for third-party advertising, ad retargeting, or cross-site tracking, and we do not sell any information collected through cookies.

## Managing Cookies
Most browsers let you view, delete, or block cookies through their settings. Because we rely on a small number of essential cookies to keep you signed in and remember your preferences, blocking them may prevent some parts of the site — such as sign-in or checkout — from working correctly.

## Changes to This Policy
We may update this policy from time to time as our services change. We'll post the current version on this page.
